MINUTES OF A MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF SHANNON MEDTECH HOLDINGS LIMITED
(Company No. 712244, CRO)
Held at the registered office on 17 September 2026 at 10:00

Present: Róisín Ní Bhriain (Chair), Cormac Gallagher, Torben Kjærgaard, Ewa Szymańska
In attendance: Gearóid Mac Suibhne (Company Secretary); Arthur Cox LLP (legal advisers)

1. QUORUM. The Chair noted that a quorum was present.
2. CONFLICTS. Kjærgaard declared an interest in item 4 as a director of the purchaser's parent and left the meeting for that item.
3. FINANCE. Szymańska presented the H1 accounts. Revenue EUR 14.2m; EBITDA EUR 2.9m. Gallagher queried the provision for the Medtronic plc supply dispute.
4. SALE OF SUBSIDIARY. The board approved the sale of Shannon Diagnostics Ltd for EUR 6,000,000 and authorised Ní Bhriain and Gallagher to sign the transaction documents.
5. DATA PROTECTION. The DPO (dpo@shannonmedtech.ie) reported one personal data breach notified to the Data Protection Commission under Article 33 GDPR on 2 August 2026.

There being no further business, the meeting closed at 11:40.
Signed: Róisín Ní Bhriain, Chair
